claim: Simon Green: OU connection first, then the official citation, which stays as written.

suggestion.to: A main-belt asteroid named after the Open University itself. Its official naming citation reads: “The Open University (founded 1969 April 23) is the world’s leading university for flexible, innovative distance learning, having educated over 2 million part-time students. Through its research in astronomy, planetary and space science, the OU has a distinguished history of involvement in major Solar System exploration missions.” The shape model of this object is awaiting further study - and it may or may not be accurately represented in this visualisation.
